settings.label: Settings navigation item
settings.explanation: The catalog generates this link. A settings declaration registers the page and its navigation together.

settings.label: Settings category
settings.explanation: The settings category groups navigation entries. It is metadata, not another page registration.

settings.label: Settings page title
settings.explanation: The catalog supplies the page title. The page.header slot adds content below this heading; it does not replace the heading.

settings.label: Settings page header slot
settings.explanation: Add content below the title. Filter pageId so this widget only appears on the Counter page.

settings.label: Settings page toolbar
settings.explanation: Place an Action here for the page toolbar. Map pageId to its input and use visible to select this page. The same Action can have other placements.

settings.label: Before Settings page body
settings.explanation: Add introductory content before the generated or custom body, filtered to this page.

settings.label: Settings page body
settings.explanation: The generated field list owns this body by default. ui/settings/page.tsx replaces it while keeping the same URL and navigation.

settings.label: Setting field
settings.explanation: This field comes from step in settings.ts. Core owns its value; App Preferences supplies the standard control.

settings.label: After Settings page body
settings.explanation: Extend a page without replacing its generated body. The owner renders matching widgets inside the page access boundary.

settings.label: Settings page footer slot
settings.explanation: Place supplementary content at the end of this page. It is a component region, not a second settings store.

settings.label: Settings navigation footer
settings.explanation: This outlet belongs to the whole Settings navigation. It is not scoped to one protected settings page.

shell.label: Header toolbar
shell.explanation: Place the Action directly with slots. Shell renders a standard button or native link at the trailing end of either header layout, before custom header.end content.

shell.label: Navigation
shell.explanation: Place the URL Action directly. Shell renders its current title and href as a native navigation link.

shell.label: Header start
shell.explanation: Place the bound link at the start of the header: left in a left-to-right layout, right in a right-to-left layout. Shell owns the position.

shell.label: Header center
shell.explanation: Use the same ActionLink in the middle header region. This is a component placement, not another Action registration.

shell.label: Header end
shell.explanation: This region accepts a component. A widget uses ActionLink to bind the existing Action; its executor is not registered again.

shell.label: Sidebar footer
shell.explanation: Place a widget below the sidebar navigation. This outlet belongs to the sidebar layout; it is distinct from the app footer and is not a navbar-footer slot.

shell.label: App footer
shell.explanation: Move the widget file to this target to render the same ActionLink in the footer. The Shell still owns positioning.
